menu: Clearance is a choice.
The void does not grade on a curve.
Probability of boredom: negligible.
Your trajectory is illogical, yet effective.
Asteroids ahead. Manners optional.
Space is empty. Your excuses need not be.
Logic suggests you press Play.
The ship is ready. Are you.
Distance is a suggestion. Survival is not.
Fascinating place for a mistake.
No life signs. Plenty of rock.
Turn left. Or right. Or become debris.
The leaderboard remembers. So does the void.
Inertia is patient. You are not.
A calm mind. A sharp arc. A short life, otherwise.
Welcome back. The asteroids missed you. Briefly.
Flight is simple. Remaining intact is the thesis.
Sensors detect ambition. Also rocks.
Live long. Or at least past the next belt.
Paper universe. Real consequences.
crash: The asteroid had the right of way. Regrettably.
That was not a gap. Noted.
Survival probability just hit zero. Efficient.
Your arc was elegant. The ending was not.
Physics filed a complaint. It won.
fuelOut: Out of fuel. The void does not tow.
You ran on sparkles. Then you did not.
Blue diamonds refill the tank. Miss enough and this is the result.
victory: Mission complete. The rocks are disappointed.
End of line. Beginning of legend. Perhaps.
modeJourney: Chart the void. Fill the Logbook.
Chapter by chapter. Catalogue as you go.
Ordered exploration. Logbook entries unlock here.
Climb the chapters. Write the field manual.
Deep space, structured. Your Logbook writes here.
modeOpenWorld: Let your name echo through space.
Endless corridor. The leaderboard is listening.
No goal marker. Only distance, and how far your name travels.
One continuous flight. Crash ends it. Fame is optional, but recorded.
The void has no exit. Your score does.
fail: Short of the mark. The goal noticed.
Try again. The rocks are waiting.
Trajectory incomplete. Ego intact. For now.
You stopped. The level did not care.
Close enough is a myth. Fascinating.
The goal was ahead. You were not.
clearPartial: The way ahead is open. The stars are picky.
You lived. The stars want more.
The chapter continues. So do the gaps.
journeyComplete: You are away. Live long and prosper.
Exosphere cleared. Nothing holds you now.
Journey complete. The void applauds quietly.
The last relay is behind you. Stay that way.
The atmosphere is behind you. Stay that way.

journey.lore: A message came to us out of the dark, torn apart by the distance. Its pieces are still scattered along the way it travelled. NAV will guide you back to find who sent it.

chapters.name: First Light
chapters.blurb: Learn the path. Listen to NAV.

chapters.name: The Long Way
chapters.blurb: Follow the signal back to its source.

chapters.name: Fragments
chapters.blurb: The message begins to take shape.

chapters.name: Deep Static
chapters.blurb: The signal is older than it should be.

chapters.name: The Senders
chapters.blurb: Piece by piece, they come into focus.

chapters.name: The Source
chapters.blurb: The trail ends at a single world.

chapters.name: Arrival
chapters.blurb: Whatever waits, you are almost there.

messages.1: There you are. Tap once. Let me see you turn.
messages.2: Rocks ahead. Don't look at them. Look at the room between them.
messages.3: That one is moving. Learn its path before you choose yours.
messages.4: See the blue light? Take it. Blue is fuel out here. It keeps you moving.
messages.5: Take the shield. For a few seconds... you can survive what should stop you.
messages.6: Good. You can fly. Now let's find whoever called us.
messages.7: We're retracing the signal's path. The old relay lanes fold the distance for us.
messages.8: The transmission crossed thousands of systems. Most of it didn't survive.
messages.9: There's an old relay ahead. Pass close. It may still remember part of the signal.
messages.10: It does. A sequence of prime numbers. Someone wanted us to know this wasn't noise.
messages.11: They began with counting. One, two, three, all the way to ten. As if to say: we think, too.
messages.12: They were trying very hard... not to be missed.
messages.13: I like them already. Keep going.
messages.14: Another relay. This fragment describes their star. Yellow. Ordinary. Stable.
messages.15: Eight planets. They lived on the third.
messages.16: Mostly ocean. One moon. A thin little atmosphere.
messages.17: They sent pictures too. The encoding is damaged... but I'm working on it.
messages.18: There are buildings. Machines. Faces, I think.
messages.19: They drew the shape they're built from. A twist of it, over and over. Their own chemistry, handed to strangers.
messages.20: And music. They put music in a message to strangers. That may be my favourite thing about them.
messages.21: Not only music. Sounds. Rain. A heartbeat. Someone, somewhere, laughing.
messages.22: They even drew a map. Here is our star, here is our world. Come find us. So trusting.
messages.23: They only sent it once. A hello into the dark, with no hope of an answer. And they sent it anyway.
messages.24: I've finished dating the transmission. There's a problem.
messages.25: It was already more than a million years old... when we received it.
messages.26: Don't stop. Old doesn't mean gone. Not necessarily.
messages.27: No later transmissions appear anywhere along the route. One message, and then silence.
messages.28: A civilization loud enough to send this... should have left something else behind.
messages.31: I recovered part of their anatomy. Two arms. Two legs. Upright.
messages.32: Five digits on each hand. Rather useful design, actually.
messages.33: Another image cleared. Blue sky. Green vegetation. White clouds.
messages.34: Fascinating. I found their name for the planet. Translation is still resolving.
messages.35: Their star has a name too. One syllable.
messages.38: I found them in the old archive... Their entire entry is one word. Unremarkable.
messages.39: Unremarkable. They sang into the dark, and we filed them under "unremarkable."
messages.40: I can see their sun from here. Yellow. Ordinary. Just as they said.
messages.41: Sol is ahead. No artificial signals. No active structures.
messages.42: Earth is still there. The ones who called... are not.

hazardLab.intro: Hazard Lab — blooms, sweeps, push nodes, wind, portals, and wells. Practice only — nothing counts toward Journey.

entries.name: Round Asteroid
entries.definition: A solid ink disc. Common, round, and lethal on contact.
entries.remark: Geometry at its most agreeable.

entries.name: Shard Asteroid
entries.definition: A triangular ink shard. Corners catch you on a glance.
entries.remark: Three points. One opinion.

entries.name: Block Asteroid
entries.definition: A square ink block. Right angles in the flight path.
entries.remark: Right angles in a wrong place.

entries.name: Side Barrier
entries.definition: Paired walls that pinch the corridor. Hit them and you are done.
entries.remark: The edges of the page also bite.

entries.name: Complex Asteroid
entries.definition: A core with orbiting moons. Smash a moon or the core; both kill.
entries.remark: One rock. Several opinions.

entries.name: Moving Asteroid
entries.definition: A pentagon that drifts left and right. Do not trust where it was.
entries.remark: Inertia has hobbies.

entries.name: Shooting Asteroid
entries.definition: A star that fires shots. Body and shots both kill without a shield.
entries.remark: It objects at range. Noted.

entries.name: Pulsating Asteroid
entries.definition: A disc that grows and shrinks. A gap that fits now may close next beat.
entries.remark: Breathing rock. Illogical, yet consistent.

entries.name: Square Bloom
entries.definition: One square blooms into four spinning ones. The shove is real; contact still kills.
entries.remark: Geometry that inhales.

entries.name: Sweep Gate
entries.definition: A slim ink blade that sweeps the corridor. Time the gap. No style bonus here.
entries.remark: A clock with teeth.

entries.name: Repulsor Node
entries.definition: A solid core with a wide push field. The core kills; the shove still logs contact.
entries.remark: Personal space, enforced.

entries.name: Drift Current
entries.definition: A full-width band of shear lines. Inside it, the ship is shoved left or right.
entries.remark: Weather with opinions.

entries.name: Wormhole Gate
entries.definition: Paired rings. Cross the entry to jump to the exit and gain a brief shield.
entries.remark: You arrive elsewhere. The rocks do not apologize.

entries.name: Black Hole
entries.definition: A well that pulls you toward its core. The body is solid; the pull still logs contact.
entries.remark: Attraction without consent. Classic.

entries.name: Space BOOP
entries.definition: The ship hits a screen edge. It compresses, squeaks, and turns sharply.
entries.remark: The universe has borders. They squeak.

entries.name: Deflector Shield
entries.definition: A Signal-Blue envelope for a few seconds. Hits smash rocks instead of the ship.
entries.remark: Temporary immortality. Do not file under permanent.

entries.name: Wall Boost
entries.definition: A thin Signal-Blue edge slab on deep runs. Bank into it for a shield and a speed burst.
entries.remark: The wall finally has manners.

entries.name: Fuel Sparkle
entries.definition: A Signal-Blue diamond that refills fuel. Miss too many and the engines die.
entries.remark: Brightness you can burn.

entries.name: Style Swoosh
entries.definition: Thread a tight gap between two obstacles. You get style points and a blue flourish.
entries.remark: Precision is its own currency.

entries.name: Deflector Smash
entries.definition: A shielded hit that pulverizes a rock. Debris flies; points and the smash count go up.
entries.remark: Manners optional. Physics mandatory.

entries.name: Finish Gate
entries.definition: A Signal-Blue stream between two wall emitters. Cross it to clear the Journey level.
entries.remark: The stream is not a suggestion.

entries.name: The Call
entries.definition: A message came to us out of the dark, torn apart by the distance. Its pieces are still scattered along the way it travelled. NAV will guide you back to find who sent it.
entries.remark: Keep moving. Listen to the voice.
